title: Tour the Stores page
blurb: See where your online shop is set up and managed.

steps.title: Open Stores
steps.body: Click **Stores**. This is your online shop, with product, cart and checkout pages built for you.

steps.title: How a store works
steps.body: Your products live in **Payments** > **Products**. Any product set to show in the online store appears here, on pages you design with the site builder.

steps.title: The store pages
steps.body: A store has a fixed set of pages: product list, product details, cart, checkout and thank you. You can restyle them but not reorder them.

steps.title: Before you sell
steps.body: You need a payment provider connected in **Payments**, shipping rates if you post goods, and a domain.

steps.title: What next
steps.body: Next: try **Set up your online store** from the Guide.
